en.headline: 1 own commit plus 9 automated; 3 issues opened or commented on
en.summary: On 2026-10-05, `sogeisetsu` logged **1 own commit** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 9 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The single own commit was a daily-report fix: the `Commits` badge no longer falls back from 0 to 1, badge layout is unified, and AI summaries are forced to use inline code. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. On the issues side, `sogeisetsu` opened or commented on 3 items: opened `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` issue #180 titled "OpenCode V2 compatibility: SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions"; opened `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` issue #458 titled "OpenCode v2 integration: fix skills install path + add mcp target"; and commented on `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` issue #254 titled "OpenCode detection & skill install path point to ~/.opencode, but OpenCode uses ~/.config/opencode".

zh.headline: 1 次本人提交，另有 9 次自动提交；新开或评论 3 个 issue
